name: Carnival Cruise Line
statusRationale: Round 3 reclassification under the round 3 category rules: the line's official page could not be read in rounds 1 to 3 (bot protection). Search-engine summaries of that page describe a permitted procedure (kept below as unconfirmed answers), but a summary is not an authoritative source, so the status is unverified until the wording is confirmed.

permitted.answer: Yes, as a scattering coordinated by the ship (not by guests on their own).

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Documented procedure; Guest Services and the Environmental Officer coordinate each request.

advanceNotice.answer: The help article says to contact the Guest Services Desk once on board. Secondary reporting says a Carnival brand ambassador has also taken requests a few days before sailing.

leadTime.answer: No pre-cruise lead time in the official article (arranged once on board). Secondary reporting quotes the brand ambassador asking for contact about two or three days before sailing.

contactDepartment.answer: Guest Services Desk on board; coordinated with the Environmental Officer.

writtenApplication.answer: No published form; Guest Services collects the preferred date and time, the number of attendees and a copy of the death certificate.

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: Yes: the deceased's death certificate and a certification that the remains were cremated by a licensed facility.

containerRequirements.answer: Biodegradable urn with a certificate confirming it is biodegradable; plastic urns, plastic ribbons, plastic flowers and balloons are not permitted.

biodegradableUrns.answer: Required, with a certificate of biodegradability.

privateCeremony.answer: Attendance limited to twelve guests, per the brand ambassador quoted in secondary reporting.

designatedArea.answer: The location may be a non-accessible area; guests may need to take stairs to reach it.

fees.answer: No charge for the ceremony, per the brand ambassador quoted in secondary reporting. Separately, the official Items Overboard Policy allows a $500 charge per violation for releasing items without ship staff permission.

distanceOffshore.answer: Beyond twelve nautical miles from land and outside any special areas; not while in port.

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: The date depends on environmental rules (distance from land, special areas). The brand ambassador (secondary) says ceremonies are subject to individual itineraries and the operational needs of the vessel.

gpsCoordinates.answer: Secondary reporting says guests receive a commemorative folder with the coordinates of the release.

certificateConfirmation.answer: A commemorative folder afterward, per secondary reporting.

differsByVesselItinerary.answer: Available from any Carnival ship but subject to individual itineraries and vessel operations, per the brand ambassador.

otherMemorialAssistance.answer: Commemorative flowers must be bought through the onboard Fun Shops and cannot include non-biodegradable ribbon or decorations. The urn must stay on the ship and may not be taken ashore in port.

name: MSC Cruises
statusRationale: Round 3 reclassification under the round 3 category rules: the line's official page could not be read in rounds 1 to 3 (bot protection). Search-engine summaries of that page describe a permitted procedure (kept below as unconfirmed answers), but a summary is not an authoritative source, so the status is unverified until the wording is confirmed.

permitted.answer: Yes, human ashes, under the Memorial at Sea service.

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Documented; time and location approved by the ship's Command.

advanceNotice.answer: Yes; notify MSC directly or through a travel agent before the cruise, then confirm time and place with Guest Services on board.

contactDepartment.answer: MSC (directly or via travel agent) before sailing; Guest Services on board.

writtenApplication.answer: Notification with ship, sail date, booking and cabin numbers, attendees, name of the deceased and urn details; no form named.

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: Not required by MSC; airport or port security may ask for a death certificate.

containerRequirements.answer: Biodegradable urn only, carried in hand luggage, with the manufacturer's certificate that it is fully biodegradable; non-biodegradable items (plastic ribbons, flowers, balloons) prohibited.

privateCeremony.answer: Group limited to no more than 10 guests (see conflicts on which regional pages say this).

designatedArea.answer: Some locations may not be wheelchair accessible; closed-toe shoes required.

distanceOffshore.answer: International waters, at least 12 nautical miles from the coast.

shipSelectsLocation.answer: Yes; time and location approved by the ship's Command.

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: Only on cruises of 6 nights or longer with at least one sea day.

gpsCoordinates.answer: Yes; the certificate shows the coordinates and time.

certificateConfirmation.answer: Certificate signed by the Navigation Officer or Captain, as a keepsake.

differsByVesselItinerary.answer: Depends on cruise length (6+ nights, a sea day); regional FAQ pages differ slightly in wording.
